notes: Photo -> merchant, date, total; editable before save. User reports the date is often wrong
integration_notes: Recommend keep (user asked for it). Closed source: rebuild from behaviour with an OCR engine we choose behind an adapter. Improve: the extracted date is never saved silently - it is shown as 'please check', defaults to today when missing or implausible (future, or older than 90 days), and the user confirms it; category is chosen from the M09 list (not extracted).
description: Photograph a receipt and get merchant, date and total filled in for you to check and save

notes: Rate source, rate date and rounding unknown; needs an exchange-rate provider and network
integration_notes: Recommend defer: adds an external rate provider and money-conversion rules that are undocumented. Data model keeps currency on every expense so it can be added later; until then an expense must be in its budget's currency.
description: Convert receipts in another currency to the budget's currency

notes: Members see every expense; spent of limit in one currency; one owner
integration_notes: Recommend keep (user asked for it). Rebuild: Budget with name, limit, currency, owner; membership-based permission check on every budget and expense read and write. Needs an accounts module (platform piece, no menu row).
description: A budget several people share, showing what has been spent against its limit

notes: Invite button seen; acceptance flow, expiry and who may invite unknown
integration_notes: Recommend keep: without it a shared budget cannot get members. Rebuild with single-use invitation tokens that expire (7 days), sent by email through an adapter; only the owner invites (safer default where Tallyho's rule is unknown).
description: Invite people to a budget by email address

notes: User saw a removed member's expenses stay in the budget
integration_notes: Recommend keep with improvements: removed member loses all access at once; their expenses stay in the budget (budget totals do not change retroactively) and are marked 'former member'; the owner sees a confirmation that says so. Decision on what happens to those expenses goes to phase 4. Phase 4: resolved (expenses stay, marked former member, access revoked).
description: The budget owner removes someone from a budget

feature: Expense records (merchant, amount, currency, date, category, budget)
notes: API: create and list by budget; types undocumented
integration_notes: Recommend keep and combine with M08 into one Expense: Tallyho's merchant, currency, date and budget plus Spendly's integer cents, validated category and note.
description: Record an expense in a budget and list a budget's expenses

notes: Exact rules unknown (day, time zone, rollover)
integration_notes: Recommend keep with a defined rule: the spent total covers the current calendar month in the budget's time zone; expenses are never deleted; no rollover. Rules not documented by Tallyho are stated as our own.
description: Each budget's spending restarts every calendar month

feature: Add an expense (amount in cents, category, note)
integration_notes: Recommend keep and combine with M06 (see M06). Spendly's integer-cents amount is kept as the money type; add the amount check Spendly lacks (positive integer).
description: Record an expense with an amount, a category and an optional note

feature: Fixed expense categories (food, travel, home, other)
integration_notes: Recommend keep (user asked for Spendly's categories): the same four categories and the same rule (unknown category rejected), adapted into the unified app's validation; used by typed and scanned expenses alike.
description: Every expense uses one of four categories: food, travel, home, other

integration_notes: Recommend drop: the user chose Spendly's categories (M09), and Tallyho's vocabulary is unknown.

feature: Public API with personal access tokens
notes: 60 requests per minute; token issuance undocumented
integration_notes: Recommend defer: not requested; adds token management and rate limiting. The unified app's own API serves its client; a public token API can come later.
description: A versioned public API for expenses and budgets with personal tokens
